description: Na₂TeS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-15°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.35 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-15°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.02 Å. Te is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of Te-S bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.40 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Te atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Te atom to form SNa₄Te square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₅Te octahedra, corners with four equivalent SNa₄Te square pyramids, and edges with five equivalent SNa₅Te octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. In the third S site, S is bonded to five Na and one Te atom to form distorted SNa₅Te octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SNa₅Te octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SNa₄Te square pyramid, edges with two equivalent SNa₅Te octahedra, and edges with five equivalent SNa₄Te square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-10°.
